notes.title: Now fully compatible with Steam Deck
notes.content:
[h1]All Hands on Steam Deck![/h1]
Great news: Nelly Cootalot: The Fowl Fleet is now fully compatible with Steam Deck, fully supports the gamepad and can be played with touch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12532752/22c0f28bf6cc5c2bf5522c3b21058d3aa1fc1caa.png[/img]

And one more thing in case you have missed it: Alasdair Beckett-King has a YouTube channel with great comedy. 
[url=https://www.youtube.com/c/ABeckettKing]Check it out here.[/url]

notes.title: Lost Treasures Adventure Bundle
notes.content:
[h2]Lost Treasures Adventure Bundle[/h2]
Follow pirate heroine Nelly Cootalot in her quest to save endangered waterfowl and seek the treasure of the Seventh Sea. And help Henry Dijon - archaeologist of the future - discover lost treasures in the legendary city of Mutropolis.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33051363/706a1e659327c9692e71b29d015224bc7b490d89.png[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/8551/Lost_Treasures_Adventure_Bundle/]Buy the bundle here: https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/8551/Lost_Treasures_Adventure_Bundle/[/url]

[h2]Mutropolis has launched[/h2]
MUTROPOLIS is a lovely sci-fi adventure set on the abandoned Planet Earth. Play as Henry Dijon (hero, nerd, detective) in search of a legendary lost city. Uncover weird ancient artifacts. And PLEASE don’t get obliterated by an ageless evil. You’ve been warned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33051363/933bf921bfb0b6e851fb1db82b9669b8d88e6875.jpg[/img]

After five years of hard work by Bea and Pablo (Pirita Studio, Madrid) the new mystery point & click adventure Mutropolis finally has launched. Here are some reactions by the press the product has received:
[list]
[*][i]one of the best adventure games that have appeared in recent years - 100/100[/i]
[url=https://itc.ua/articles/mutropolis-vesyolye-arheologicheskie-raskopki-v-mire-budushhego/]itc.ua, Yuri Melkov[/url]
[*][i]An enjoyable adventure and a first class debut for Pirita Studio - 85/100[/i]
[url=https://ragequit.gr/reviews/item/mutropolis-pc-review/]ragequit.gr, George Dembegiotis[/url]
[*][i]Exciting detective story with great characters and lots of love for archaeology. - 75/100[/i]
[url=https://www.4players.de/4players.php/dispbericht_fazit/PC-CDROM/Test/Fazit_Wertung/PC-CDROM/42788/84769/Mutropolis.html]4players.de, Maja Verfondern[/url]
[*][i]Mutropolis is an absolute recommendation for any point-and-click lover. - 8/10[/i]
[url=https://indieplanet.de/tests/mutropolis-im-test-pc-verrueckte-reise-zurueck-zur-erde/]indieplanet.de, Christina Knauf[/url]
[*][i]interesting puzzles, good humor and a good audio/visual setting 9/10[/i]
[url=https://forum.przygodomania.pl/viewtopic.php?f=1302&t=7732]forum.przygodomania.pl, Urszula Kuchmistrz[/url]
[*][i]a good choice for all fans of point-and-click and logic games 92/100[/i]
[url=https://www.omegascopio.com.br/jogos/mutropolis-e-um-puzzle-desafiador-e-inteligente-critica/]omegascopio.com.br, Julia Barcelos[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: Commentary Ahoy!
notes.content:
[h1]Developer commentary[/h1]
We have updated [i]Nelly Cootalot: The Fowl Fleet[/i] with a developer's commentary. Alasdair Beckett-King and real Nelly (aka Rachel) sat down and recorded funny and interesting background information. The audio tracks unlock as you play and you can listen to them whenever you want. This may be a good reason to play the game again if you have finished it already or another reason to buy it if you haven't bought it yet.

[h1]Gamepad support[/h1]
Now the version for PC, Mac and Linux supports gamepad/controller input. For PC it should work with standard XBOX and compatible controllers. We know that there are many controllers out there, so we can't promise all of them will work. We did our best to support most models and picked a very popular library to add controller support.

For macOS it depends what kind of controller you have and how it is supported by system extensions. XBOX compatible controllers work for us.

For Linux we support the standard profile for controllers. Our tests with XBOX compatible controllers have been successful.

notes.title: Soundtrack and Deluxe Bundle available
notes.content:
[h1]Ahoy, you landlubbers![/h1]
We have published the original soundtrack for Nelly Cootalot: The Fowl Fleet as a DLC. It contains all the original music.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1069330/Nelly_Cootalot_The_Fowl_Fleet__Original_Soundtrack/]The DLC is available here[/url]

A short time ago the first Nelly game called "Nelly Cootalot: Spoonbeaks Ahoy!" [b]was[/b] been released in an HD remastered version, featuring a full voice over by Alasdair Beckett-King and [b]real Nelly[/b]. You can find it for a [b]ridiculously tiny[/b] price here
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/763030/Nelly_Cootalot_Spoonbeaks_Ahoy_HD/]here[/url]

And we have created a bundle containing The Fowl Fleet and Spoonbeaks Ahoy! so you can get it even cheaper!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/11144/Nelly_Cootalot_Deluxe_Bundle/]Buy the Deluxe Bundle or add the missing piece at a discount[/url]

notes.title: The Press Gang - review round up!
notes.content:
So it looks like people like Nelly. Good! We'll let the reviewers tell it in their own words:

[i]"It’s funny, daft, and the look is incessantly fantastic... And it’s got Tom Baker in it. I had a thoroughly lovely time."[/i]
- John Walker, [url=https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/2016/03/22/nelly-cootalot-the-fowl-fleet-review/]Rock, Paper, Shotgun[/url]

[i]"The puzzles are as perfect as possible."[/i]
- [url=http://justadventure.com/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=3337]Just Adventure[/url]

[i]"A joy to play through from start to finish... easily one of the most enjoyable adventures of 2016."[/i]
8/10 - [url=http://www.cubed3.com/review/2702/1/nelly-cootalot-the-fowl-fleet-pc.html]cubed3[/url]

[i]"The characters are all wonderful, with Nelly in particular being a lovable scamp"[/i]
8.5/10 - [url=http://www.gamewatcher.com/reviews/nelly-cootalot-the-fowl-fleet-review/12512]gamewatcher[/url]

[i]"An amazing adventure game. Its story has surprising depth, the characters are lovable, the puzzles are great fun and it wraps it all up in a layer of fantastic humour!"[/i]
4.5/5 - [url=http://thementalattic.com/2016/03/22/review-nelly-cootalot-the-fowl-fleet/]The Mental Attic[/url]

[i]"One of the funniest games I have played in recent years."[/i]
5/5 - [url=http://www.kickstartadventure.com/home/nelly-cootalot-the-fowl-fleet-review/]KickstartVenture[/url]

[i]"Lovingly crafted and amounts to a very relaxing and enjoyable point ‘n click experience."[/i]
- [url=http://techraptor.net/content/nelly-cootalot-review-peck-n-click]Techraptor[/url]

[i]"A delightful point-and-click romp of swashing and buckling. In short, it’ll straight up charm your knickers off."[/i]
Buy it! - [url=http://www.vgblogger.com/review-nelly-cootalot-the-fowl-fleet/37088/]vgblogger[/url]

[i]"Go play Nelly Cootalot: The Fowl Fleet. I highly recommend it."[/i]
- [url=http://spacequesthistorian.com/2016/03/22/nelly-cootalot-the-fowl-fleet/]@SQHistorian[/url]
